briefing.headline: US-China AI compute gap narrows as DeepSeek-R2 challenges GPT-5 frontier

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward multimodal agents while regulatory scrutiny intensifies ahead of US midterms. Compute shortages persist despite massive new data center announcements. DialectForge gains traction in enterprise security pilots.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with native tool use; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; Google drops Gemini 3 Ultra; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant. DeepSeek-R2 matches o3 performance at 40% lower inference cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST updates AI RMF with mandatory red-teaming for models over 100B parameters.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC Arizona fab ships first 2nm wafers to Microsoft and xAI; Saudi Arabia commits $40B to sovereign AI cluster; NVIDIA Blackwell supply remains constrained through Q1 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10-trillion-parameter model trigger a verifiable intelligence explosion before 2028?
